messages:
ryan: Quick sync — post‑MVP we need a lightweight playbook for bugs vs enhancements. Proposing: short hotfix window for P1/P2, group P3s into 6‑week minor releases. Need concrete owners and criteria.

maria: +1. Can we capture a clear rubric so CS and eng triage consistently?

alex: From eng side we also need estimates up front. If P2s are large we should move some to the enhancement wave.

tara: Draft rubric suggestion:
```
P1: crash/data loss/security -> fix within 48h (hotfix)
P2: high freq user-impact, core flow degrade -> fix within sprint or next hotfix window
P3: UI polish, low-frequency asks, “nice-to-have” -> backlog + 6-week release grouping
```

sam: Telemetry note: I'll add signal thresholds for "high freq" (>=1% of traffic or error spike x3 baseline). Will post the dashboard widget.

ryan: Proposal for cadence: P1/P2 handled by ad hoc hotfixes with 2-week stabilization windows; P3s get a controlled grouping every 6 weeks. Owners: maria (P1 triage), alex (P2 scheduling), tara (P3 grooming). Thoughts?

maria: I can own P1 triage. I'll set up the tracker and own customer comms for urgent accounts. :white_check_mark:

alex: OK to own P2 scheduling. Quick capacity update: we can commit ~30% of team cycles to hotfixes for the next 4 sprints, then reassess. P2 that require >2 dev-weeks should be reclassified to P3 unless customer SLA demands otherwise.

tara: I'll run backlog grooming and propose grouping rules (e.g., by surface area + risk). Will add rollback policy for grouped releases.

deploy-bot: Incident runbook link: <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/post-mvp-hotfix> (auto-posted)

sam: I'll instrument the key signals and push a weekly digest to #product-telemetry. Also will add a small eval set to catch regressions for top 5 flows.

ryan: Actions: 1) maria -> create tracker (DoR: columns: id, priority, owner, ETA, customer impact) by EOD. 2) alex -> update roadmap milestone + capacity note. 3) tara -> RFC for P3 grouping and rollback policy in doc. 4) sam -> dashboard + weekly digest. I'll schedule a 30m sync Thu 11:00 to finalize. @maria @alex can you confirm?

maria: Confirmed. I'll ping CS and include top 3 paying customers in the tracker.

alex: Confirmed. Will add estimates for current P2s and flag any that need reclass.

tara: Confirmed. Draft RFC by tomorrow.

ryan: Great — :thumbsup: If anything comes up before Thu, drop into this thread.

sam: Added initial dashboard widget. Will DM the owners when thresholds breach.

maria: Tracker created: https://redwood.internal/trackers/post-mvp-hotfix (stub). Starting triage now.

alex: ETA note: P2 batching estimate ~3 dev-weeks for current queue (subject to reprioritization).

tara: RFC link will be in next comment.

ryan: Last call — anyone blocking?

alex: Nothing blocking from eng, just need final list from maria for customer‑driven P1s.

maria: Sending list in 15.

ryan: Perfect. See you Thu 11am.
